fr.text: Ne poursuis pas Singed : sa Piste empoisonnée (A) te ronge pendant toute la chasse, et pendant ce temps tu perds ta wave et ton temps.
Garde tes distances : sa Projection (E) te lance derrière Singed, vers ses alliés, et te root si tu atterris dans son Attrape-mouche (Z), qui bloque aussi tes dash.

en.text: Don't chase Singed. His Poison Trail (Q) keeps eating your HP the whole way, and meanwhile you're losing your wave and wasting time.
Keep your distance. Fling (E) tosses you behind Singed, toward his team, and roots you if you land in Mega Adhesive (W), which also stops your dashes.
